TUI Names Johan Lundgren as Next Chairman of the Supervisory Board
By Adam Whittaker
German travel group TUI said Johan Lundgren will be its next chairman of the supervisory board once Chair Dieter Zetsche stands down at the end of his term in February.
TUI said Friday that Zetsche decided not to seek re-election and will vacate the position at the end of the annual general meeting in February next year. He had served as chairman since May 2019.
Lundgren--a former TUI executive who also has lead British airline easyJet--was elected unanimously. He has sat on the supervisory board sine 2025.
